impact: Employees and dependents in the county health plan may have had names, Social Security numbers and limited health details exposed; the county gave no number. HIPAA Journal reports 5,684,735 individuals being notified across Marathon Health.
date_note: Date of the WRTV report. Marathon Health says the incident occurred on 24 August 2026; county employees learned of it on 6 November.
title: Boone County, Indiana, employees affected by breach at health clinic provider Marathon Health
summary: Boone County, Indiana, says employees and dependents in its health plan are affected by a cybersecurity incident at Marathon Health, which runs its employee clinic; its own systems were not breached. Marathon told WRTV it was a voice-phishing attack contained the same day. HIPAA Journal, citing law firm Emery Reddy, says Texas was told 5,684,735 individuals are being notified.
plain: A company that runs Boone County's employee health clinic was hacked. Staff and family members may have had personal and health details exposed.
exec: A vendor breach exposed government employees' Social Security and health data; the county network was not involved.
action: Affected employees: watch for the Marathon Health letter, place a credit freeze and monitor accounts and health insurance statements.

sources.name: HIPAA Journal: Marathon Health data breach reportedly affects 5.7 million individuals

key_findings: Marathon Health incident occurred 24 August 2026; county employees became aware on 6 November.
Data may include names, addresses, dates of birth, health insurance IDs, Social Security numbers and limited diagnosis or treatment information.
Marathon describes a vishing attack, contained the same day; county says its own network was not breached.
recommendations: Contact HR about the Marathon Health letter.

validation.note: County impact is reported by one Indiana I-Team report (WRTV, copied by WISH-TV). HIPAA Journal separately reports Marathon's notice and the 5,684,735 figure (attributed to Emery Reddy) but does not name Boone County.

review.note: summary length shortened; validation: county impact is one report (WRTV/WISH-TV), now single_source

evidence.quote: the Texas Attorney General was informed that 5,684,735 individuals are being notified
